# Model-Discrimination-DES-SN5YR — AI-readable index (llms.txt)

> Methods paper: model discrimination in the DES-SN5YR Hubble diagram is
> highly sensitive to the simulation-derived bias-correction (BBC) layer.
> Headline: released-vector verdict +1.1 (flat LCDM over a static probe
> law); reconstructed pre-BBC verdict +12.8; pairwise leverage
> L_BBC = -11.7 — eleven times the verdict's size, moved TOWARD the
> alternative. No cosmological claim. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22022089.
